title: Oleshky Local Ceasefire Takes Effect; Russia Halts Fire on Kherson Axis
detail: The localized ceasefire around Oleshky took effect on Oct 27 (3 a.m. Kyiv time per Latin Times, citing Al Jazeera). It had held for over 30 hours by Oct 28, though aid delivery and civilian movement were not yet confirmed and mined roads were still being cleared. An estimated 1,700-2,000 residents are stranded without power, heat or water. Peace talks are tentatively set for Nov 4 per Latin Times (single-source).

title: Russian Drones Hit Kharkiv's Osnovianskyi District Twice; One Killed, Eight Injured
detail: A Russian drone attack overnight Oct 27 injured five in Kharkiv's Osnovianskyi district, including a four-year-old; on Oct 28 a second drone killed a 60-year-old man and injured three. Ukraine struck industrial targets in Lipetsk and Novomoskovsk. Single-source (Latin Times); treat as unconfirmed.
